body:
The root sqlb facade exposes expression, statement, binding and execution APIs. render owns SQLer, Args and the minimal Dialect contract. dialect/* supplies engine spelling; expr builds typed expressions; stmt owns statement structure and Query; bind couples expressions to pointers; exec uses database/sql-compatible DBTX; scan adds value readers. schema and ddl form the optional schema path, and pg/mysql/sqlite/ch hold engine constructs. Contrib modules isolate drivers and tooling from the root dependency budget. Keeping these boundaries explicit makes it possible to import or extend a lower layer without adopting the facade.
